input.quote: enter into a new subordination agreement with a new lender(s) on terms and conditions that are taken as a whole not less favorable in any material respect to SFJ than those set forth in the subordination agreement to be entered into with SVB
input.rationale: Searches for MFN/best-terms language (most favoured, no less/not less favourable, at least as favorable, best price, match, comparable terms) returned no pricing or best-terms MFN in the Agreement. The only "not less favorable to SFJ" language is Section 7.5 (p0543), which is a condition on any replacement lender subordination agreement in the security-interest package, not an obligation for PB to extend SFJ the benefit of better terms granted to third parties. Article 6 (Payments to SFJ) and the Licensing Transaction definitions/Section 7.5.5 (p0552) impose consent and approval mechanics on PB's third-party licensing, but no obligation to offer SFJ terms no less favourable than those given to others or to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on PB), so no redline is proposed.
